label: extension

args.subject: Group booking enquiry – 10 guests in June
args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to ask about availability for 10 people in June.

Could you please let us know which dates in June have availability, along with group rates and any booking conditions? If you need specific dates from me, please tell me and I will send them.

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text:
I emailed groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp, the group-bookings address from one of the City Hub reviews. The hotel is listed in the system as "City Hub".

The email asks about availability for 10 people in June, plus group rates and booking conditions. It also says you can send specific dates if they need them. I signed it as you, Emma Johnson of Blue Sparrow Tech.

I haven't received a reply, so nothing is confirmed yet.
